sources.entry: iSponsorBlockTV ⚠ - Block and skip sponsors, while also muting and skipping ads on YouTube. GPL-3.0 Docker/Python

summary.one_liner: iSponsorBlockTV is a self-hosted app that connects to YouTube TV apps on your devices and automatically skips sponsor/intro segments using the SponsorBlock API, and can mute and skip ads.
summary.what_it_does: Runs on a computer with network access and connects to YouTube TV apps on devices such as smart TVs and game consoles. It uses the SponsorBlock API to automatically skip segments in YouTube videos, such as sponsors or intros. It can also automatically mute YouTube ads and press the "Skip Ad" button as soon as it becomes available. Devices can be found by auto discovery on the same network during setup, or added manually with a YouTube TV pairing code from the YouTube TV app's settings page. The README says a Textual-based graphical configurator is included. The README lists compatibility with many devices, marked as working, and notes limitations for AirPlay ad muting and for Shorts.
use_cases: skip sponsors in YouTube videos on a TV
auto-skip intros on smart TV YouTube
skip YouTube ads automatically on game console
control YouTube TV app from a server
how_to_run: Installation instructions are in the project wiki (the README says 'Check the wiki').
notable: Connects to YouTube TV apps on many devices, including Apple TV, Samsung Tizen, LG WebOS, Android TV, Roku, Fire TV, and consoles
Uses the SponsorBlock API to skip segments such as sponsors and intros
Auto mutes ads and presses the Skip Ad button when available
Auto discovery of devices via SSDP, or manual pairing with a YouTube TV code
caveats: YouTube changed its screen ID format and is revoking existing codes, so devices may need to be paired again
Ad muting does not work when audio is sent to another speaker via AirPlay
Shorts are not fully supported due to limitations on YouTube's side
